# Pushy
> Pushy is a reliable push notification gateway for time-sensitive, mission-critical mobile and web applications.

Pushy provides lightning-fast, highly reliable push notification delivery with cross-platform support, delivery analytics, and managed infrastructure for production applications.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://pushy.io/): Overview of Pushy’s push notification platform, reliability, speed, and supported platforms.
- [About](https://pushy.io/about): Company background, mission, and information about the Pushy team.
- [Pricing](https://pushy.io/pricing): Pricing plans, usage tiers, and feature comparisons for Pushy services.
- [Enterprise](https://pushy.io/enterprise): Enterprise-focused offering, scalability, support, and custom deployment options.
- [Contact](https://pushy.io/contact): Contact form and sales inquiry page for prospective customers.
- [Support](https://pushy.io/support): Support resources and contact options for existing users.
- [Terms & Privacy](https://pushy.io/terms-and-privacy): Legal terms, privacy policy, and service usage conditions.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://pushy.io/docs): Main documentation portal for integrating and operating Pushy.
- [Support](https://pushy.io/support): Help resources for troubleshooting account, integration, and delivery issues.
- [Service Status](https://status.pushy.me/): Real-time operational status for Pushy services and infrastructure.
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.pushy.me/): Web console for managing apps, devices, notifications, and analytics.

## Platform Access
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.pushy.me/): Manage applications, API credentials, devices, and push notification campaigns.
